help.title: Using BizTrack: A Quick Guide
help.BizTrack is your go-to business manageme: BizTrack is your go-to business management tool designed with small business owners in mind. It's an all-in-one platform that helps you effortlessly manage your products, track orders, and stay on top of your finances. Let me walk you through the basics:
help.The Dashboard is your central hub, givin: The Dashboard is your central hub, giving you a snapshot of your business's overall performance. Here, you'll find key metrics like total expenses, revenues, profits and the number of orders. It's your command center for a quick overview.
help.Head to the Expenses page to add your bu: Head to the Expenses page to add your business expenses. Fill in the date, choose a category, enter the amount, and jot down any notes. It's that simple.
help.Edit or Delete Expenses: Made a mistake?: Edit or Delete Expenses: Made a mistake? No worries! You can easily edit or delete expense records right from the Expenses page.
help.On the Orders page, you can keep tabs on: On the Orders page, you can keep tabs on all your orders. Each entry details the product, quantity, and order status.
help.effortlessEditingBody: Need to update an order status? Click the "Edit" button and make your changes. It's hassle-free.
help.Need to update an order status? Click th: Need to update an order status? Click the "Edit" button and make your changes. It's hassle-free.
help.Adding a New Expense, Order or Product: Adding a New Expense, Order or Product
help.addStepOpen: Click on "Add Expense" or the equivalent button on the order or product page.
help.Click on \"Add Expense\" or the equivale: Click on "Add Expense" or the equivalent button on the order or product page.
help.Fill in the product details or order det: Fill in the product details or order details or transaction date, category, amount, and any notes.
help.addStepDone: Hit "Done," and you're all set. Your order, product or transaction will now appear in the respective page and on the Dashboard.
help.Hit \"Done,\" and you're all set. Your o: Hit "Done," and you're all set. Your order, product or transaction will now appear in the respective page and on the Dashboard.
help.Click on any column heading (headers) to: Click on any column heading (headers) to sort the entries in the table by that column in either ascending order or alphabetical order.
help.You can also search for a particular pro: You can also search for a particular product, order or expense by entrering the value in the search box at the top of the respective page.
help.exportBackupBody: Want to keep a backup or analyze your data elsewhere? Simply click on "Export to CSV" to download a CSV file with all your business data.
help.Want to keep a backup or analyze your da: Want to keep a backup or analyze your data elsewhere? Simply click on "Export to CSV" to download a CSV file with all your business data.
help.BizTrack is designed to be intuitive, us: BizTrack is designed to be intuitive, user-friendly, and adaptable to your business needs. Explore the different pages, try out the features, and let BizTrack simplify your small business management.
help.Have questions, feedback, or just want t: Have questions, feedback, or just want to connect? Feel free to reach out!

It's not just a project; it's my answer to the chaos that comes with managing a business.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Your privacy matters
privacy.BizTrack is a client-side small-business: BizTrack is a client-side small-business dashboard. Products, orders, expenses, language preference, and cookie consent are stored in this browser through localStorage.
privacy.No account system, analytics tracker, ad: No account system, analytics tracker, advertising cookie, or server-side personal-data collection is used by this version of the application.
privacy.You can remove stored records at any tim: You can remove stored records at any time by clearing this site's browser data. Exported CSV files are created locally and are controlled by the user after download.
